title: LemonCloud Cobblemon
description: Battle your way through Gyms, chase down legendary spawns, and prove yourself against the best. LemonCloud Cobblemon delivers a polished, optimised Pokémon experience in Minecraft.
body:
![LemonCloud logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f775cbd9f7e238bca56e93c3d78ff489d5374605.png)

Welcome to LemonCloud! We're a latest version 1.21.11 Minecraft network focused on fast-paced progression, competitive economies, and long-lasting servers. Whether you enjoy grinding, building empires, or playing casually with friends, LemonCloud offers high-quality gamemodes with constant updates and an active community.

You can play any of these gamemodes:

### Cobblemon
A Pokémon-in-Minecraft experience powered by Cobblemon, combining exploration, battles, and progression in a carefully balanced world.

### Prison
Progress through custom mines, powerful enchants, and prestiges in a fully reworked Prison experience designed for both grinders and PvP players.

### Factions
Classic Factions with modern features — build powerful bases, raid enemies, dominate the economy, and compete for top rewards every season.

### Skyblock
Start from nothing and build your island empire with custom generators, upgrades, and competitive island progression.

### Survival / SMP
A refined survival experience with quality-of-life features, player shops, and a friendly community — perfect for long-term play.

### Server Info

Java IP: cobblemon.lemoncloud.org
Bedrock IP: cobblemon.lemoncloud.org
Bedrock Port: 19132

- Website: https://www.lemoncloud.org
- Store: https://store.lemoncloud.org
- Discord: https://discord.gg/lemoncloud

Join LemonCloud today and become part of a growing network built for players who love progression, competition, and community.
